text:
customer_ops: Hey team — starting ~09:40 UTC our EU customers saw spikes of 503s and higher latency. We're seeing a billing surge too. Traffic SHOULD be pinned to our Dedicated EU pool (reservation eu-west-1), but it looks like a lot of requests went to hosted. Can someone check routing + auth?

ela.system (infra-bot): Reserved capacity check: reservation eu-west-1 active, 8/8 GPUs healthy.

eva_support: Sorry you're seeing this. Can you paste a failing request_id and a short curl repro? Also, are tokens coming from the reserved API key or the org key?

customer_ops: request_id=rc-20260315-9f3b, example trace attached below. We always use the dedicated key for this tenant. Quick curl (scrubbed):

```\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED-DEDI-KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-6b","prompt":"hi","region":"eu-west-1"}'
```

li_engineering: I pulled the trace for rc-20260315-9f3b — router decided fallback to hosted after auth check returned 200 but pool affinity lookup returned NO_BIND. That suggests the pin metadata TTL may have expired or didn't propagate to the regional router cache.

sam_platform: Confirming: cache snapshot at 09:39:58 shows pin_ttl for tenant_id 1257 expired 09:39:57. But reservation still active on controller. There's a mismatch between controller and regional edge cache.

customer_ops: Why would TTL expire while reservation active? We renewed the reservation yesterday.

li_engineering: Two likely causes: 1) controller's pin-refresh job failed to write TTL touch to the cache due to intermittent memcache errors, or 2) the edge received an old revision of the pin record because of a race during failover. I'm seeing memcache 500s around 09:38 in infra logs.

noah_billing: Billing noticed a delta — ~40% of requests for that tenant were billed at hosted unit rates between 09:40-09:52. We're going to need a retro credit if this was unintended. Keep logs of which requests hit hosted.

eva_support: For repro: can you run a quick curl loop from the customer's network and include header X-Request-Id incrementing, we'll map in logs. Also send the org+tenant id in DM.

customer_ops: Running now, sample curl lines included. Also attaching one 503 stack snippet:

```\n[2026-03-15T09:41:03Z] router: route_decision fallback_to_hosted reason=NO_BIND edge_cache_version=1745
[2026-03-15T09:41:03Z] auth: token_ok scope=dedicated_key tenant=1257
[2026-03-15T09:41:03Z] hosted_proxy: forward 503 upstream_rate_limit
```

li_engineering: That log strongly suggests cache TTL expiry + immediate fallback rather than auth failing. Quick mitigation: we can temporarily set a sticky override for tenant 1257 on regional router to force-dedicated until root cause fixed. Will need infra approval.

sam_platform: I'm patching a hotfix to make the pin-refresh job more resilient (retry + write-through to both memcache and redis). Scheduling immediate rollback window. ETA for deploy 15m.

eva_support: infra-bot, can you set a temporary routing override? Tagging @sam_platform for approval.

infra-bot: Routing override request received. Approval needed from platform team.

sam_platform: Approved. Creating override: tenant=1257 scope=eu-west-1 action=force_dedicated expires_in=60m.

li_engineering: Override in place. I verified new requests are now hitting dedicated pool and 503s stopped within ~90s of override.

customer_ops: Confirmed — traffic back to dedicated and latency normalized. Thank you. Please confirm billing credits and root cause/action items. :relieved:

noah_billing: Put a temporary credit hold on the hosted-charge delta and opened a billing ticket BILL-8762. We'll reconcile after RCA.

sam_platform: Action items: 1) revert pin-refresh retry fix through canary and monitor, 2) add alert when controller/edge cache diverge > 30s, 3) run a targeted memcache incident postmortem for 09:36-09:42 window.

li_engineering: Also adding a guard: if reservation controller reports active reservation, router should not fall back for 30s without verifying with controller. I'll open PR.

eva_support: I'll follow up with customer and close once billing and RCA are confirmed. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

customer_ops: Appreciated. Please keep us posted with the RCA link and the billing ticket.
